port_discrepancies: Current hotkey handling does not preserve the source owner guard for 126/127/128/129/130/136: HandleHotkeyBeforeFocusedUi routes several keys directly to ToggleWindow, and there is no V/136 route. Current handler has no Alt+V case.

source_contract.guild: If basic-info owner exists and guild ID is nonzero, attempt DeleteWindow(59); only if absent, create WID_GUILDWND. Return 1 even when guards prevent an operation.
source_contract.pet: If basic-info owner exists, attempt DeleteWindow(88); only if absent, create WID_PETINFOWND. Return 1 even when owner is absent.
source_contract.party_setting: If basic-info owner exists, first attempt DeleteWindow(53); only if it was absent and GetNumParty()!=0, create WID_PARTYSETTINGWND. Return 1 even when guard prevents an operation.

port_discrepancies: Current Alt+G calls ToggleWindow(WID_GUILDWND) without the source basic-info-owner or nonzero-guild-ID guard and uses visible-state toggle semantics instead of delete-before-create. A retained hidden guild instance is shown by MakeWindow rather than deleted as the source DeleteWindow-first branch requires.
Current manager has WID_PARTYOPTIONWND (0x95), not WID_PARTYSETTINGWND (source ID 53); no party-setting hotkey/lifecycle route was found in current manager code.
Current manager has no WID_PETINFOWND or pet-info hotkey/lifecycle route.

findings.source_contract: UpButton picks the first non-null target in priority order: choose, say-dialog, combo-box, choose-warp, metal-list, edit-window. It sends message 18 to that one target. If none exists, it walks children and sends message 18 to every child whose IsFrameWnd() is true.
findings.port_discrepancy: No equivalent manager UpButton or general message-18 frame broadcast was found. Current OnKeyDown routes Up/Down specifically to select-server and to a few focused/modal controls; other arrows fall through. Evidence: src/ui/UIWindowMgr.cpp:3211-3337.

findings.source_contract: Key 68 (D) changes screen 110 or 120 to 100; screen 2 to 1; all other screen states are unchanged. Each path returns 0; it does not create a detail-level window.
findings.port_discrepancy: No D/detail-level screen transition or SetcurScreen implementation was found under src/ui; current pre-focus hotkey switch has no D case. Evidence: src/ui/UIWindowMgr.cpp:3065-3105.

These references only close, invalidate, define, or handle the command-list window. ProcessPushButton key VK_Y (89) is default for the selected invocation per command-root-routes.json; key 121 is VK_F10 and its case routes chat behavior, not command-list creation. Alt+Y tooltip text is not source proof of an entry point.
